# Skazka Tours

> Private, small-party safaris in Kenya, planned and led from Nairobi since 2015. Parties of two to six, one guide for the whole trip, no fixed itineraries. Founded by Kimani Kennedy Muna, a KPSGA silver guide and former electrical engineer. Guiding in English, Swahili and Russian.

## How a trip is made

1. A conversation, typically 45 minutes by video.
2. A written draft route, clearly priced, with the reasoning for every choice, delivered in 3–5 days.
3. On the ground with the same guide every day, from arrival to departure.
4. Plans change daily when the trip calls for it.

Price includes everything after landing: camps and lodging, meals, transfers including charter flights, park and conservancy fees, guide, crew and concierge. International flights and visas are not included.

## Sample journeys (starting points, not fixed packages)

- The Great Rift, end to end — 12 days, Nairobi → Amboseli → Laikipia → Maasai Mara, from $14,800 per person, shared
- Samburu & Laikipia — 7 days, from $9,400 per person, shared
- Mara Classic, our way — 10 days, private conservancies, from $12,600 per person, shared
- Coast, craft & bush — 14 days, Tsavo, Lamu, Malindi, from $16,200 per person, shared
- The short sabbatical — 5 days, Laikipia conservancy, from $6,800 per person, shared

## Regions

Maasai Mara (best Jul–Oct; private conservancies only), Laikipia (year-round; walking, rhino, wild dog), Samburu (Jun–Mar), Amboseli (Jun–Oct, Jan–Feb; elephants), Lamu & the coast (best Nov–Mar), Tsavo (Jun–Oct).

## Booking

Six to twelve months ahead is comfortable; July–October is often full a year out. Children welcome; guests as young as five have travelled with us, at a calmer pace.
